penalties.name: Fare Evasion / Ticketless Travel
penalties.description: Travelling without a valid ticket or failing to tap in.
penalties.additional_charges: Full single fare of the intended journey.

early_payment_discount.notes: If paid within 14 days via the app, the fine is reduced to $50.00 plus the full single fare.

penalties.name: Smoking and Vaping
penalties.description: Smoking or vaping in any indoor or outdoor station premises and train carriages.
penalties.enforcement: Immediate removal from station/carriage and fixed penalty notice.

penalties.name: Carrying Prohibited Items
penalties.description: Bringing flammable materials, hazardous chemicals, or prohibited electric vehicles (e.g., e-scooters) onto the network.
penalties.enforcement: Denial of entry, confiscation of item if dangerous, and fixed penalty notice.
